narr: A strong cold front moved through the Mid-South during the late afternoon and early evening hours on October 23rd. The front interacted with some marginal instability and scattered showers and thunderstorms developed resulting in locally heavy rain. Flash flooding occurred in Tupelo.
ev: High water along Main Street outside a department store in Tupelo.
lsr: HIGH WATER ALONG MAIN STREET OUTSIDE OF A DEPARTMENT STORE IN TUPELO.
